newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian interbank rates steady, trade slackens.
newsitem.headline: Croatian interbank rates steady, trade slackens.

text.p: Croatian interbank rates remained unchanged amid somewhat lower kuna liquidity on Wednesday morning, dealers said.
"There were somewhat less kuna funds on offer today, compared to Tuesday's figures," one dealer told Reuters.
But she said demand was also weak and left some 30 million kuna ($5 million) on the supply side.
Fresh borrowings totalled 10.6 million kuna, most of which were call money loans granted at a steady 10.5 percent.
Term loans struck at 12 and 13 percent accounted for some 2.1 million kuna fresh trade.
Monday overnight trade was 50 million kuna as one bank sought funds to maintain its mandatory reserve. -- Sandra Kalogjera, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075 ($ = 5.948 Croatian Kuna)
